data.title: Course fee invoice for the Grundkurs couples dance course
data.summary: Tanzschule Beispielschritt confirms Anton Musterschmidt's registration for the "Grundkurs Paare" couples dance course starting 14 January 2027 and asks for payment of the €168.00 course fee (for ten evenings) by 25 January 2027 to keep the reserved spot.
data.explanation: This is a confirmation of your dance course registration together with the invoice for the course fee. Transfer the €168.00 fee using the reference given so your place in the course stays reserved. Note that the letter names two different payment deadlines (25 January and 3 February 2027) — to be safe, pay by the earlier date. If you don't pay, your reserved spot may not be guaranteed.
